payload.name: PreserveNamedActivitiesInAffectiveEventMemories
payload.description: When extracting memories from a message where a person explicitly names an activity tied to an emotion or evaluation during an event, include the named activity in the memory content.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly names an activity (e.g., dance, hike, sing) and connects it to an emotion or evaluation (e.g., freeing, magical, enjoyable), record both the activity and the emotion in the memory content. Do not replace the concrete activity with a general adjective summary.
Preserve the specific action or actions mentioned so that later questions about what was freeing, enjoyable, or otherwise evaluated can be answered from the memory.

solves: During extraction, named activities tied to explicit emotions or evaluations are sometimes dropped, leaving only summary adjectives. This makes later questions about the concrete activity unanswerable. Future inputs where a speaker names an activity during an event and attaches an affective evaluation should retain that activity in memory content; not applicable when no activity is named.
